ui.sdkGuestHint: Sign in to the community account to use SDK channel downloads
ui.noGameVersions: This resource lists no supported versions
ui.noFile: No directly downloadable file for this resource; get it from the resource homepage.

ui.noHorizons: There are no horizons yet. Create one in the Resource Center first, or switch to "Download file only".
ui.folderHint: The file will be saved directly to this folder without any category placement.
ui.folderCancelled: No folder selected (the folder picker is unavailable in browser preview)

cloud.label: Dynamic Cloud Background
cloud.hint: Slowly drifting fluid clouds; palette switchable

dark.label: Deep Dark
dark.hint: Very dark gray, easy on the eyes

light.label: Bright Light
light.hint: Clean light gray-white; text flips to dark automatically

default.label: Follow Theme
default.hint: Use the default glass surface color

slate.label: Slate Tint
slate.hint: Neutral dark grey, low-key and versatile

navy.label: Navy Tint
navy.hint: Deep blue tone, calm and steady

nav.customHint: Pick any color with the system color picker; it is applied at roughly 72% opacity to keep the frosted glass look.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Browse the skin library and community appearances, then apply your own skin.

resources.title: Resource Library
resources.desc: Multi-source version manifests and loader lists; choose any download channel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Manage the root directory, game directories and download sources.

java.title: Java Environment
java.desc: Automatically scans common JDK directories and the .minecraft bundled runtime; you can also pick javaw.exe manually.
java.empty: No Java environment found. Use the button below to select javaw.exe manually (usually inside the bin folder of a Java installation); its version is parsed and added to the list immediately.

msa.title: Microsoft Account Verification
msa.desc: Authorize via the Microsoft device code flow to complete Xbox Live, XSTS and Minecraft authentication, retrieving the official UUID, game name and skin avatar.
msa.deviceHint: Open the verification page in your browser and enter the user code below to authorize your Microsoft account.
msa.copiedPaste: Copied, paste it in the browser
msa.deviceMeta: The code is valid for about {minutes} minutes; this page updates automatically once authorization succeeds.
msa.requesting: Requesting a device code from Microsoft…
msa.notBound: No Microsoft official account bound yet. Click the button at the top right to start verification.

offline.title: Offline Accounts
offline.desc: The UUID is derived to the standard format via the MD5 of OfflinePlayer:nickname, used only for singleplayer and offline login.
offline.placeholder: Enter an account nickname, up to 16 characters
offline.empty: No offline account yet. After adding one you can switch the current account in the list.

home.offlineLimitHint: You can create at most {limit} offline accounts
home.offlineEmpty: No offline account yet. After adding one, click the card to set it as the current launch account.

recent.title: Recent Updates
recent.desc: Minecraft release records; see the full list in Resource Center.
recent.empty: Version list not available yet. Please retry later in Resource Center.

console.title: Error Console
console.desc: Streams the game process's stdout and stderr line by line and points out the cause when launch fails; the full log is written to logs/launch.log.
console.empty: No launch logs yet; process output will appear here in real time after launching the game.

progress.hint: The overlay closes automatically after launch completes

launchDialog.title: Select a Horizon to Launch
launchDialog.desc: Each horizon is an independent game directory; the game launches with that horizon's configuration.
launchDialog.needAccountTitle: Please select an account to launch first
launchDialog.needAccountDesc: Click an official or offline account card in the account panel on the right of the home page, set it as the current launch account, then start the game.
launchDialog.empty: No horizon yet. Download one in Resource Center or create one on the Horizons tab.

user.notBoundCommunity: Not logged in to iGCraftLit Community account

launchDock.needAccount: Please select an account to launch in the account panel on the right

section.accountDesc: Unified entry for managing the community account, Microsoft official account and runtime environment.
section.horizonDesc: Each horizon is an independent game directory; mods, resource packs, shaders and saves do not affect one another.
section.resourcesDesc: Multi-source version manifests and loader lists; you choose the download channel and the launcher never switches it automatically.
section.settingsDesc: The root directory and game directories are managed by the launcher; you choose the download channel.

news.title: News Feed
news.desc: Launcher release notes and server announcements, always up to date.
news.empty: No news yet. You can maintain it in the local news.json.

paths.title: Launcher Root Directory
paths.desc: The launcher generates the root directory name from your OS and builds the full launcher_data and .minecraft structure under the root you choose.

detect.title: Auto-detect Game Directory
detect.desc: Scans common system locations and your saved custom paths; a directory is complete when assets / libraries / versions all exist.
detect.empty: No .minecraft directory detected. Click [Add Scan Directory] to pick one manually, or click [Generate Standard Structure] to create the full structure under the root directory.

channel.title: Download Channel
channel.desc: The channel is chosen by you; the launcher never switches or downgrades automatically. When the selected channel is unavailable it only notifies you and waits for a manual switch.
channel.sdkDesc: Distributed via the main site backend, with account authentication and acceleration; requires the backend online (available when the tunnel is up).
channel.directDesc: The launcher's local engine connects directly to official and mirror sources without the main site backend, and works offline independently.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Background mode, color scheme, frosted-glass blur and theme color; changes take effect across the whole launcher immediately.
appearance.blurHint: Adjust the backdrop-filter blur radius for the nav bar, cards and other elements, previewed in real time.
appearance.navHint: Choose a base color for the nav bar while always keeping the frosted-glass look; pick a preset tint or use the system color picker.

plaza.title: Block Plaza
plaza.desc: One-stop entry for P2P rooms, the client sync hall and horizon management.

horizon.title: Horizon Management
horizon.desc: A horizon is an isolated game directory: mods, resource packs, shaders and saves stay independent of each other, while shared assets / libraries / versions are reused from the root directory.
horizon.guestLimit: Guests can create at most {limit} horizons. Sign in with a community account to remove the limit.

worlds.empty: No saves in this horizon (the saves folder is empty)

list.title: Horizon List
list.empty: There are no horizons yet. Enter a name above and click [New Horizon] to generate an isolated directory.

modal.nameRequired: Please enter a horizon name first, e.g. 1.20.1-Fabric
modal.versionRequired: Please choose the downloaded version to bind to this horizon
modal.versionsEmptyHint: No downloaded versions locally. You can create the directory now and download the version later from the Resource Center.

library.title: Skin Library
library.desc: A curated collection of 100 built-in skins, browsable by All and Featured; also look up any player's skin online and manage your own local skins.

online.label: Online Lookup
online.desc: Enter a player name to look up any skin

viewerEmpty.library: Select a skin on the left to preview the 3D result

apply.noOfflineHint: Please add an offline account in Account Center first; the target is the current offline account.

profile.title: Premium Account Profile
profile.desc: Textures come from the Mojang session service profile API and are used only for local 3D display.
profile.emptyNoAccount: No Microsoft premium account is bound yet. Please complete verification in Account Center first.

resource.desc: {total} versions in total; {shown} shown in the current category. Click a card to open the install dialog.

resource.limitHint: This category has many versions; only the first {limit} are shown. Use a keyword to narrow down.
resource.loadingLoaders: Loading available versions for this loader on this game version…
resource.rootHint: A standard iGML_Matrix directory structure (.minecraft / horizons, etc.) will be created under this path before downloading.

source.remote: Public server list fetched from a third-party API; you can query live status and join with one click.
source.cache: Currently offline; showing the locally cached server list.

server.addDesc: Fill in the server name and address to add it to the list. Port defaults to 25565; the website link is optional.
server.emptyLoaded: No servers yet. Click "Add Server" in the top-right to add one manually, or refresh the list later.
server.manifestHint: A directly hosted JSON. Once filled in, use "Launch & Sync" on the card: the local engine fetches the manifest directly and reconciles mods and config, never through the main-site backend.
server.syncNeedHorizon: Create and select a horizon first; syncing writes into that horizon directory.
server.syncNeedAccount: Select an account in the right panel on the Home page first.
server.syncPreviewDisabled: Launch-and-sync is unavailable in browser preview; please use the desktop launcher.
server.centerDesc: Generate a client sync manifest for your server so players can sync and join in one click.
server.manifestToolDesc: Scan the mods and config folders of the selected horizon and generate a manifest.json containing file paths, sizes and SHA256 hashes.
server.manifestNoHorizon: No horizons yet. Create one in "Horizons" first.
server.manifestGuideText: Package the client mods and upload them to GitHub or a cloud drive, then upload the generated manifest to get a direct link and fill it into the player's server info (Client Sync Manifest URL).
server.manifestPreviewDisabled: Cannot scan local directories in browser preview; please use the desktop launcher.

hall.title: Client Sync Hall
hall.desc: Add server entries and fill in an externally hosted manifest direct link. Clicking "Launch & Sync" makes the local engine fetch the manifest directly, compare hashes and fill in missing mods and config — never through the site backend.

studio.title: Client Manifest Studio
studio.desc: Scans mods and config in the server directory. Tick the files to sync to players and generate manifest.json plus a client ZIP in one click.
studio.noServer: No local server yet. Create one under "Local Hosting" below, then generate a client manifest for it.
studio.emptyFiles: No files found under this server's mods or config directory.
studio.scanHint: Click "Rescan directory" on the left to start scanning.
studio.guideText: Upload the ZIP to a cloud drive or GitHub to get a direct download link, fill that link into manifest.json, then send the JSON address to your players.
studio.previewDisabled: Cannot scan local directories in browser preview; please use the desktop launcher.

local.title: Local Hosting
local.desc: Choose a server core and game version; the launcher downloads the core and creates a local server directory, then pair it with the Manifest Studio above to sync clients to players.
local.empty: No local server yet. Click "Create Server" to set up your first one.
local.loaderHint: Only required for Fabric / Forge / NeoForge; Vanilla and Paper need no value.
local.needVersion: Please select a game version first.
local.needName: Please enter a server name first.
local.previewDisabled: Creating local servers is unavailable in browser preview; please use the desktop launcher.

phase.manualInstall: The server core has been downloaded. No usable Java runtime was detected; please run the installer manually to finish setting up the server.

horizon.label: Multiplayer Horizon
horizon.empty: No Horizons yet. Create one in the Horizons tab, or download a version from the Resource Center.
horizon.none: Select a Horizon first, then create or join a room.

host.title: Host mode
host.desc: Create a multiplayer room after selecting a Horizon, share the 6-digit room code, then open the game to LAN.
host.inRoomDesc: Room is ready. Share the room code below, then follow the guide to host.
host.guide: In-game, press ESC and click "Open to LAN", then note the port number shown in chat.
host.portHint: Enter the port shown in the chat bar when you "Open to LAN" in game; friends can join once bound.
host.bound: Port {port} bound. Friends can now join.

guest.title: Friend mode
guest.desc: Enter the 6-digit room code from the host; after joining, launch the game and the world appears under Multiplayer.
guest.guide: In-game, click Multiplayer and double-click the LAN world that appears.

info.title: Dual-transport multiplayer
info.community: Fast community relay: while the community site is online, the launcher registers the room over its WebSocket and exchanges signaling for the lowest latency.
info.public: Public relay fallback: when the community site is offline, it switches to EasyTier public relays and punches through via public STUN/TURN.
info.udp: UDP broadcast forwarding: the tunnel forwards the game's UDP LAN-broadcast packets so friends can discover the room directly in the multiplayer list.
